title: Stay Out the Zone Tres Idiomas
style: modern afrobeats viral pop, log drum bass, syncopated percussion, bright marimba, smooth female lead with male hype calls, three-language verse rotation, pickleball coaching anthem, club ready uplifting, 104 bpm, viral hook
lyrics:
[Intro]
Stay out the zone, stay out the line
Non-volley zone, you cross it you fine

[Verse 1 — English]
Seven feet from the net, that is the rule
Step inside the line, you look like a fool
No volley, no smash, no jumping in
Feet behind the line if you wanna win
Wait for the bounce, then you can play
Non-volley zone, that is the way

[Chorus — Tres Idiomas]
Stay out the zone, fuera de la zona, lí kāi jiă chú
Feet behind the line, pies detrás, jiǎo zai hòu
Wait for the bounce, espera el bote, děng qiú luò
Stay out the zone, fuera de la zona, lí kāi jiă chú

[Verse 2 — Español]
Siete pies del net, esa es la ley
Si pisas la zona, te llaman buey
Nada de volea, nada de saltar
Los pies bien atrás, eso es ganar
Espera el bote, luego juega
Fuera de la zona, esa es la regla

[Chorus — Tres Idiomas]
Stay out the zone, fuera de la zona, lí kāi jiă chú
Feet behind the line, pies detrás, jiǎo zai hòu
Wait for the bounce, espera el bote, děng qiú luò
Stay out the zone, fuera de la zona, lí kāi jiă chú

[Verse 3 — 中文]
Qī yīng chǐ wǎng, g uī zé qī ng chǔ
Cǎi xían xīng, jiù shì shū
Bù néng jié jirong, bù néng tiào
Jiǎo bù guò xiàn, cái néng yián
Děng qiú luò di, zài dǎ huíu
Lí kāi jiă chú, wǒ men gùo

[Bridge]
Do not step in, no entres ahí, bù yào jin qù
Wait for the bounce, that is the move
Espera el bote, busca el groove
Děng qiú luò, jié zou yí dao

[Outro]
Stay out the zone, fuera de la zona, lí kāi jiă chú
Viral viral, viral viral
Stay out the zone forever
